reviewer: independent modeling_ui agent; did not author or modify body data/reproducer
scope: Pinned CC0 body/target/rig DATA provenance, literal-only safety, source-index geometry/age/weights/landmark trace, independent reconstruction and static manifold invariants. No GPT reconstruction or visual/business-quality pass.

upstream.mesh_and_target_provenance: Same exact OBJ and young/old bytes independently verified in previous baseline and age reviews
upstream.license_observation: Both official rig/weight JSON files explicitly declare CC0. Pinned LICENSE.md distinguishes AGPL program code from CC0 graphical assets, listing the base mesh/proxies and targets/modifiers among its examples.
upstream.subject_inference: Source artist-baseline filenames are provenance only; no identity or ethnicity inferred from the user subject. No MakeHuman program code imported or copied.

rig_trace.method: Independently traverse official bone ancestry, collect per-source-index weights and use math.fsum per family divided by all official weights. Independently calculate joint means using official bone head/tail joint-index lists.
rig_trace.joint_anchor_geometry_note: Some official rig landmark means use non-BODY helper vertex indices as numeric anchors, but only source BODY faces/vertices are retained as mesh geometry.

reproduction.authoring_format_step: Apply repository Ruff format to the NEW private generated file using the same installed Ruff version

checks: quad indices and positive fan triangle areas
single connected component and no unused vertices
finite bounded arm/hand pairs summing at most1 and hand subset of arm
finite landmarks/frame heights with matching age keys
five finite digit anchors per hand

limitations: This fixed generic artist baseline is not reference reconstruction. Image-driven shape, pose, clothing, hidden-surface consistency and final output realism require separate validation.
Data topology checks do not establish runtime deformation quality or absence of self-intersections under all parameter combinations.
No model calls, neural weights, user reference geometry, or MakeHuman program logic used in this review.
